races.name: Oddschecker Bet Builder 'National Hunt' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
Best Odds At Oddschecker Mares' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
Jon Shepherd 60th Birthday Celebration Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
Free Bets oddschecker.com Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
British EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
It's hard to see past SOD HALL LANE who has made a bright start and came clear in good style at Hamilton 4 weeks ago.

  1. SOD HALL LANE (IRE)
  2. SABLE NOIR (IRE)
  3. JUST FOR MONTY

races.name: Weatherbys Racing Bank Selling Stakes
races.verdict:
WALSINGHAM is favoured by the weights dropped into selling company and is fancied to resume winning ways at the chief expense of stablemate Kaleido who also holds solid claims on these terms. Hat-trick seeking Sunriseontheboyne and Nostrum can't be dismissed either in a competitive event.

  1. WALSINGHAM (IRE)
  2. KALEIDO
  3. SUNRISEONTHEBOYNE (IRE)

races.name: Invades Day Party Handicap
races.verdict:
C&D scorer FILEY BEACH rates the pick of the weights despite being raised 3 lb for his most recent Catterick success so looks the way to go. Monhammer goes very well round here and is a big danger in his bid for a fifth C&D victory, while Misemerald can also have a say.

  1. FILEY BEACH (IRE)
  2. MONHAMMER
  3. MISEMERALD (IRE)

races.name: Dropkicks Split The G Nursery
races.verdict:
Most of these arrive with a question mark against them so it could pay to side with BRANDENBURG who had the worst of the draw when well held in a York nursery on his debut for Ann Duffield and had won twice prior to that. The First Drop is weighted to go well if a switch to nursery company sparks a resurgence and is next on the list ahead of Redcar scorer Rock Steady Beat.

  1. BRANDENBURG
  2. THE FIRST DROP
  3. ROCK STEADY BEAT (IRE)

races.name: Weatherbys Stallion Book Handicap
races.verdict:
AZUINTHEJUNGLE continues on the up and is fancied to garner a fifth success of 2026 off a still handy-looking mark following a cosy recent success at Newcastle. Hat-trick seeking Startling also arrives better than ever and rates a big danger, while Mo Of Cairo and Hanney Girl also need factoring into this competitive sprint.

  1. AZUINTHEJUNGLE
  2. STARTLING
  3. MO OF CAIRO

races.name: Global Home Of Outdoor Advertising Nursery
races.verdict:
STAY ON TAB looked a different proposition when making all in the mud at Hamilton on Monday and it's easy to see him defying a penalty if in the same sort of form here. Yorkshire Dream might be the danger.

  1. STAY ON TAB
  2. YORKSHIRE DREAM (IRE)
  3. CALEF (IRE)

races.name: Join Racing TV Now Handicap
races.verdict:
RIDDIKULUS has been rejuvenated since the blinkers went back on and can bag a third win of the season on the back of a good Ripon second. C&D scorer Bollin Neil could emerge as the main danger ahead of Falaise Blanc and Aighear in this tight-knit handicap.

  1. RIDDIKULUS
  2. BOLLIN NEIL
  3. FALAISE BLANC (FR)

races.name: Racing To School Nursery
races.verdict:
DUCHESS OF IMMATIN has improved with each start to date, subject to no more than largely hands-and-heels riding when opening her account at Kempton last week. She looks to have been found an excellent opportunity on nursery debut with further progress in the offing. Bladey Lady can emerge as the chief danger back down in class.

  1. DUCHESS OF IMMATIN (IRE)
  2. BLADEY LADY (IRE)
  3. JOHNS POWER

races.name: EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
GOLD KEY got a much fairer crack at things and duly stepped up plenty on his debut effort when finishing a very good second behind a subsequent winner at Thirsk 7 weeks ago. Open to further progress, he can confirm the promise of that run and make it third time lucky. Rupert The Brave has gone the right way in 3 starts to date and is a live threat from a handy draw, with Muhandes expected to build on a promising debut fifth at Leicester.

  1. GOLD KEY (IRE)
  2. RUPERT THE BRAVE (IRE)
  3. MUHANDES (IRE)

races.name: Watch All Races Live On RacingTV Handicap
races.verdict:
Preference is for LADY PHOEBE, who had been in good form upped in trip on the Flat prior to disappointing over hurdles on her latest outing. She is worth another chance returned to this sphere, though Sugarpiehoneybunch is respected following her wide-margin success over C&D last time. Muhib completes the shortlist.

  1. LADY PHOEBE (IRE)
  2. SUGARPIEHONEYBUNCH (IRE)
  3. MUHIB

races.name: Bet At racingtv.com Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
MASABAN produced a career best when making all at Musselburgh last time and, with more still to offer over this trip, he is taken to follow up. Golden Strike arrives on the back of going close at Newmarket and is feared most, ahead of 4-time course winner Evocative Spark.

  1. MASABAN (IRE)
  2. GOLDEN STRIKE (IRE)
  3. EVOCATIVE SPARK (IRE)

races.name: Bet At racingtv.com Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
MO ANAM CHARA got the job done in cosy fashion on her yard debut at Thirsk earlier in the month and looks capable of defying 7 lb higher mark. Three-time C&D winner Vince Le Prince and Yaajooz head the opposition.

  1. MO ANAM CHARA (IRE)
  2. VINCE LE PRINCE
  3. YAAJOOZ (IRE)

races.name: racingtv.com Handicap
races.verdict:
WITHOUT DELAY has been shaping up well here in recent weeks and now dropped back to a sprint trip for the first time since her juvenile days, Tracy Waggott's mare could be the answer. She gets the nod over Mister Sky Blue, who gives his running more often than most at this level but finds winning difficult. Golden Prosperity can edge out Society Charm for third.

  1. WITHOUT DELAY (IRE)
  2. MISTER SKY BLUE (IRE)
  3. GOLDEN PROSPERITY (IRE)

races.name: Amstel Gallop Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
GREEN AREA's clear-cut success over a now-useful sort at Carlisle 6 weeks ago reads very well and with further progress expected from Charlie Johnston's low-mileage filly, she makes plenty of appeal on handicap debut. Prince Of Calypso had excuses on account of a wide trip at Beverley last time and a better showing is anticipated. Thriving Irish mare Ina Mina and Wardlaw complete the dangers.

  1. GREEN AREA
  2. PRINCE OF CALYPSO (IRE)
  3. INA MINA

races.name: Racing Again 17th October Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
races.verdict:
Hanging under pressure probably just cost JOJO RABBIT at Pontefract last week given he went down only narrowly to Albegone, so it's reasonable to assume he can reverse the form with that rival and come out on top. So Grateful has been knocking on the door from his reduced mark this season and also needs considering.

  1. JOJO RABBIT
  2. ALBEGONE
  3. SO GRATEFUL

races.name: Gilna's Of Laytown Optional Claiming Maiden
races.verdict:
NAUTIC STAR has been out of the frame just once in her 8 career starts and this looks a good opportunity for Jessica Harrington's filly to get off the mark. Heading up the dangers is Donna Time, who found listed company all too much on just her fourth career start in the summer but can get back on track returning in much calmer waters. Elusive Path and Senna's Girl round off the shortlist.

  1. NAUTIC STAR (IRE)
  2. DONNA TIME (IRE)
  3. ELUSIVE PATH (IRE)

races.name: Gilna's Of Laytown Optional Claiming Maiden
BOYLE Sports Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict:
THE BLUE PANTHER went close from this mark on his penultimate start and now starting out for another new yard in reapplied cheekpieces, he's put forward as the answer. Last-time-out winners Platino Bianco and Chavajod look the most obvious threats, with Are You In Or Out one to keep an eye on at forecast longer odds from her much-reduced mark.

  1. THE BLUE PANTHER (IRE)
  2. PLATINO BIANCO (IRE)
  3. CHAVAJOD

races.name: Rathbarry & Glenview Studs Handicap
races.verdict:
Lots with chances but RED HUGH O'DONNELL didn't enjoy the rub of the green when sixth in a big field at Listowel last time and can double his tally for the season off a 2 lb lower mark here. Givehertilxmas should go well off a handy-looking mark, especially if the fitting of a visor ekes out some improvement and heads the list of dangers. Mickey The Steel, Moyassr and Mythical Rock also enter calculations in this competitive handicap.

  1. RED HUGH O'DONNELL (IRE)
  2. GIVEHERTILXMAS (IRE)
  3. MICKEY THE STEEL

races.name: Johnny Sullivan Memorial Maiden
races.verdict:
OSTERODE advanced her form when runner-up at Down Royal at the start of the month and looks to have been found an excellent opportunity to go one better for her in-form handler. Dusty Rock has an 8-month absence to overcome but remains likely to do better and could still emerge as the main danger ahead of Famed Again.

  1. OSTERODE (IRE)
  2. DUSTY ROCK (IRE)
  3. FAMED AGAIN (IRE)

races.name: Gannon City Recovery & Recycling Handicap
races.verdict:
HARRY'S HILL was successful from this mark on his penultimate outing at the Curragh and having been out of his depth back there last weekend, Martin Hassett's veteran is fancied to take his record here to 3-4. Nouvel Espoir has made the frame more often than not in competitive sprints this year, so he can give the selection most to think about, with the returning Bay of Supremacy taken to fill out third.

  1. HARRY'S HILL
  2. NOUVEL ESPOIR (IRE)
  3. BAY OF SUPREMACY (IRE)

races.name: Paddy Woods Memorial Apprentice Series Final Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
SCORCHER'S SON is from an excellent family and looks to have been allotted a lenient opening mark based on what he's achieved in maiden company, so he's an appealing candidate. Sneddy Eddie has improved over jumps since joining Gordon Elliott and looks interesting from a basement rating back in this code, while in-form pair Justenzia and Miss Australie are others to consider.

  1. SCORCHER'S SON
  2. SNEDDY EDDIE (IRE)
  3. JUSTENZIA (IRE)

races.name: Paddy Woods Memorial Apprentice Series Final Apprentice Handicap
SIS Maiden
races.verdict:
MISSISSIPPI SHINE shaped well without being given a hard time when fourth in a big-field Navan maiden on his recent debut and this son of Camelot can take a sizeable step forward over this longer trip and get off the mark. The reliable Pierre Grosse is worth forgiving a rare poor effort at Haydock last time and has the form to go very well, while the high-class chaser Solness has just his third Flat run here but still enters calculations.

  1. MISSISSIPPI SHINE (IRE)
  2. PIERRE GROSSE
  3. SOLNESS (FR)

races.name: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
REAL BULLET is taken to make it 3-3 but will likely have to work to give significant weight away. Quai Louis shaped a lot better than the result on his 7f turf debut and is taken to provide the main threat ahead of recent Wolverhampton 2-4 Birkett Bank and Marhaba Ya Tayib. The newcomers also need checking out in the betting.

  1. REAL BULLET
  2. QUAI LOUIS (IRE)
  3. BIRKETT BANK

races.name: Try Unibet's New Smartview Racecards Nursery
races.verdict:
The way ARCTIC TSAR asserted late on at Leicester suggests there is more to come and he can make light of a 6 lb rise. Xochipilli and Hidden Beyond are potential improvers making a quick switch to nurseries and head the dangers along with Royal Titan, who promises to benefit from the return to 7f.

  1. ARCTIC TSAR (IRE)
  2. XOCHIPILLI
  3. HIDDEN BEYOND (AUS)

races.name: Bet 20 Pound Get 20 Pound With Unibet Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
MUQARRABIN is an expensive £450,000 purchase, the first foal of a 1m-10.2f winner related to smart performers and makes plenty of appeal on debut for top connections so should go close. Wootton King is also very well bred so makes similar appeal, while Encounter has shown a reasonable level of form that could give him a place chance with experience on his side.

  1. MUQARRABIN
  2. WOOTTON KING
  3. ENCOUNTER (IRE)

races.name: Bet 20 Pound Get 20 Pound With Unibet Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
JINMAN left his debut form well behind despite still looking rather green when third in a Leicester novice 3 weeks ago and, with the step up to 1m expected to suit, he can build on that and come out on top. Talamon has similarly showed promise and is expected to be on the premises, while Votadini and Sabulo are likely types among the newcomers.

  1. JINMAN (FR)
  2. TALAMON (USA)
  3. VOTADINI

races.name: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap
races.verdict:
Oisin Murphy takes over in the saddle on MR FUSTIC who shaped quite well at Wolverhampton last time and is narrowly preferred to Hove Ranger, who has all-weather handicap form figures of 211. Lovely Jubly has posted 2 good efforts over C&D this season and is next on the list.

  1. MR FUSTIC (IRE)
  2. HOVE RANGER (FR)
  3. LOVELY JUBLY

races.name: Industry Leading In-Play Markets At Unibet Handicap
races.verdict:
VENETIAN LION has proved most progressive since a tongue strap was fitted, completing his hat-trick at Pontefract 13 days ago with more in hand than the bare margin so he's going to be tough to stop up 5 lb. Sea Founder makes loads of appeal back up to 1m but isn't the best drawn and may have to settle for a place, while Silent City looks interesting on all-weather debut.

  1. VENETIAN LION
  2. SEA FOUNDER
  3. SILENT CITY

races.name: ebfstallions.com Conditions Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
A smart conditions race featuring 3 Group 1 winners. KIND OF BLUE seemingly isn't quite the same force as when winning the Champions Sprint at Ascot a couple of years ago but his second to Elmonjed in a York Group 2 in the spring shows he's still highly talented on his day. He gets a narrow vote over Wise Approach, who should prove suited by the return to 6f, and Mitbaahy.

  1. KIND OF BLUE
  2. WISE APPROACH (IRE)
  3. MITBAAHY (IRE)

races.name: Try Unibet's New Improved Acca Boosts Handicap
races.verdict:
INTERSTATE didn't enjoy the smoothest of trips when third at Newbury 12 days ago having won in first-time blinkers at Newcastle the time before. He can resume winning ways back on all-weather. Tiernan was possibly unsuited by conditions when sixth at Ayr but had shaped well at this track the time before and is feared most, while Cape Fear is a 3-y-o that could improve further.

  1. INTERSTATE
  2. TIERNAN (IRE)
  3. CAPE FEAR

races.name: Get Best Odds Guaranteed At Unibet Handicap
races.verdict:
BIG BARD served warning that he's ready to strike when running on late over 5f last time and is one to take very seriously back over C&D. Beelzebub isn't long with the Tony Carroll yard so could well have more to offer and looks a big threat, while Southbank is lurking on a good mark again now.

  1. BIG BARD
  2. BEELZEBUB (IRE)
  3. SOUTHBANK (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares Beginners Chase
races.verdict:
FUTURE PROSPECT can provide Willie Mullins and Paul Townend with a third successive win in this contest. Amen Kate and Sixandahalf are useful hurdlers and may give her most to do if taking to fences.

  1. FUTURE PROSPECT (IRE)
  2. AMEN KATE (IRE)
  3. SIXANDAHALF (IRE)

races.name: Gracie's Bar Beginners Chase
races.verdict:
HELLO NEIGHBOUR achieved the best hurdles form of these, is related to a multiple-winning chaser and is taken to make a successful debut in this sphere. Putapoundinthejar and Bowensonfire rate the main dangers in what should prove an informative maiden chase.

  1. HELLO NEIGHBOUR (IRE)
  2. PUTAPOUNDINTHEJAR (IRE)
  3. BOWENSONFIRE (FR)

races.name: Eddie McAllister Memorial Novice Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
MINERS BRIDGE justified strong support with something in hand at Killarney last month and he looks one to keep on the right side following his first chase success. He is taken to get the better of Soldante, who resumed winning ways at Kilbeggan on his latest outing, with Stuntman Steve also considered.

  1. MINERS BRIDGE (IRE)
  2. SOLDANTE (IRE)
  3. STUNTMAN STEVE (IRE)

races.name: Frank O'Beirne Memorial Beginners Chase
races.verdict:
AFFINITY ROCK had made a positive start over fences prior to a lesser effort at Ballinrobe, so she is worth another chance to build on previous promise. She gets the vote ahead of River Tara, who had looked the likely winner when departing late on her chasing debut, while Down Around could go well on his first chase start.

  1. AFFINITY ROCK (IRE)
  2. RIVER TARA (IRE)
  3. DOWN AROUND (IRE)

races.name: Brenda Anderson Memorial Handicap Chase (0-100)
races.verdict:
SWING TIME was impressive last time and is taken to defy a hefty rise in another ordinary handicap chase. Mobile Mamma hasn’t really kicked on from her stable debut/return, but that form stands up well and the return to chasing could spark a revival. Hurricane Honey returned to form last time and can be involved if backing up that performance here.

  1. SWING TIME (IRE)
  2. MOBILE MAMMA (IRE)
  3. HURRICANE HONEY (IRE)

races.name: Christy 'Frosty' Callaghan Memorial Chase
races.verdict:
STRAIGHT HOME showed she retains her ability at the second time of asking back from an absence when runner-up at Ballinrobe recently and can build on that and go one better now, possibly at the expense of stablemate Soir De Garde, who is the mount of Paul Townend. Chanceawetmorning should also have a say if suffering no ill effects from his late fall at Kilbeggan.

  1. STRAIGHT HOME (IRE)
  2. SOIR DE GARDE (FR)
  3. CHANCEAWETMORNING (IRE)

races.name: Sligo Races Handicap Chase (0-100)
races.verdict:
WESTERN MODEL shaped well when second over fences at Downpatrick recently and is taken to build on that promise and prove too strong for course specialist Cornmarket and last month's Tramore runner-up Pourquoi Poi. The fact Ballagh Star has won the last 2 runnings of this race means it would be no surprise were he to leave a string of poor efforts behind.

  1. WESTERN MODEL (IRE)
  2. CORNMARKET (IRE)
  3. POURQUOI POI (IRE)

races.name: Welcome To Nelson Mandela Bay Maiden Plate (3-Year-Olds)
races.verdict:
SEATTLE GLOW formwise has a clear edge and there is no need to look elsewhere for the winner. Weekend In Aspen is also in with a shout, while Highway Code is one to bear in mind too.

  1. SEATTLE GLOW (SAF)
  2. WEEKEND IN ASPEN (SAF)
  3. HIGHWAY CODE (SAF)

races.name: Racing Today Apprentice Open Maiden
races.verdict:
BAI YULU quite clearly has the best form and is hard to look past. Apples And Tea makes most appeal of the rest, while Caughtubysurprise has a place chance as well.

  1. BAI YULU (SAF)
  2. APPLES AND TEA (SAF)
  3. CAUGHTUBYSURPRISE (SAF)

races.name: Play Soccer 6, 10 And 13 Fm 90 Handicap (F & M)
races.verdict:
LADY ELLIOT just about edges it as the selection but others can't be discounted in an open contest. Haze And Smoke is not one to underestimate however, while White Waters edges it as the selection for third.

  1. LADY ELLIOT (SAF)
  2. HAZE AND SMOKE (SAF)
  3. WHITE WATERS (SAF)

races.name: youcanbetonus! Mr 74 Handicap
races.verdict:
SOUNDSOFSYMPHONIES holds an appreciable advantage on the form book and would be folly to overlook. Icy Lancaster is preferred for the forecast, while Wordsworth is another with place prospects.

  1. SOUNDSOFSYMPHONIES (SAF)
  2. ICY LANCASTER (SAF)
  3. WORDSWORTH (SAF)

races.name: Racing240 Middle Stakes
races.verdict:
WAROFDYNAMITE has been hard to fault in recent outings and is the one they all have to beat. Roaming Spirit could be the toughest opponent, while Sports Fan could also figure.

  1. WAROFDYNAMITE (SAF)
  2. ROAMING SPIRIT (SAF)
  3. SPORTS FAN (SAF)

races.name: Tab 4Racing App Apprentice Classified Stakes
races.verdict:
ALADO'S PRIDE formwise is a fair way in front of these and has an excellent chance. Sabrage is likely to be waiting in the wings if the selection fails to deliver, while Welsh Starlet may be the one for third.

  1. ALADO'S PRIDE (SAF)
  2. SABRAGE (SAF)
  3. WELSH STARLET (SAF)

races.name: Tab Telebet 011 074 0300 Mr 68 Handicap
races.verdict:
TORI'S GIRL failed to justify support last time but that was still her best effort to date and she gets the vote again. Global Speak is another who could have a big say in proceedings, while Preserve Forever can also go well.

  1. TORI'S GIRL (SAF)
  2. GLOBAL SPEAK (SAF)
  3. PRESERVE FOREVER (SAF)

races.name: www.tab.co.za Mr 78 Handicap
races.verdict:
KING VISERYS comes here on a roll and is fancied to complete a quick-fire hat-trick. Hoodwinked seems sure to be snapping at the selection's heels, while Vila Vicosa merits respect also.

  1. KING VISERYS (SAF)
  2. HOODWINKED (SAF)
  3. VILA VICOSA (SAF)

races.name: Next Fairview Racemeeting Friday 2 October Fm 74 Handicap (F & M)
races.verdict:
POTENZA is holding her form well and will probably take the beating. Morfeliha could provide the chief threat, while Alex Miller edges it for third.

  1. POTENZA (SAF)
  2. MORFELIHA (SAF)
  3. ALEX MILLER (SAF)

races.name: Prix Du Chateau Narbonnais Maiden Stakes
Prix De La Croix Blanche Stakes
Prix De La Foret Mormal - Monte
Prix De La Foret De Phalempin - Attele
Prix De L'olympique Rugby Marcquois - Attele
Race 7 - Itoba Stallion Season Fillies Handicap
